checkpoint: P8E explicit task invocation resource owner
purpose: Validate the smallest explicit product invocation boundary that receives task plus caller-owned resources before planning, normalizes them through the P8B task resource contract, and invokes normal runTask with taskResourceContext as its only visual-knowledge option. The default interactive CLI remains unchanged and receives no implicit resource context.
requiredClaims: task-invocation.js accepts only version, task and resources at the product invocation boundary
task text is preserved exactly rather than normalized into planner/resource metadata
resources are normalized by the already validated P8B task-resource-context boundary
relative/invalid resource identity fails closed before runTask

alternate visual knowledge fields including documentPath, taskResourceContext, visualFallbackCallerContext, visualFallbackContracts and visualFallbackDependencies are rejected at the invocation schema
runTask is invoked exactly once with taskResourceContext as its only option
invalid invocation never reaches runTask and failed runTask is not retried by the invocation boundary
task-invocation.js performs no UI, Computer Control, semantic snapshot, OCR, Vision or filesystem path discovery
agent-loop.js does not import task-invocation.js and the default interactive CLI still calls runTask(task) without taskResourceContext
agent-loop.js remains documentPath-free and planner output remains resource/provenance-free
Computer Use and Computer Control product trees remain clean
nonClaims: This contract-only session is not a physical UI validation.
The invocation boundary preserves explicit resource provenance supplied by its caller; it does not independently prove filesystem ownership or freshness by inspecting the UI or filesystem.
This session does not make taskResourceContext implicit in the interactive CLI.
This session does not add document.open or a new Computer Control mechanic.
This session does not authorize generic Pulsar visual fallback or any target other than the already bounded P7D/P7E knowledge when later resolved by runTask.
P8D remains the authoritative physical validation until the invocation boundary itself is physically exercised.

onPass.nextCheckpoint: P8E physical validation: exercise the real task-invocation product boundary with an explicit temporary Pulsar current-document resource and prove the same semantic-first visual fallback path without direct fixture invocation of runTask.

evidencePolicy.onFailure: Preserve s01 unchanged, diagnose the exact product/test contract failure, fix forward, and create s02.
evidencePolicy.sensitiveData: No screenshot bytes, OCR payload, visual coordinates, user file contents or user file paths are required by this contract-only session.
